# Current branch `01_whole-app-game`

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of `01_whole-app-game` is to demonstrate an example app-package (i.e., a shiny application stored in an R package). 

## Launch

You can launch the `monthAppPkg` application in `01_whole-app-game` by running the contents in the `app.R` file

``` r
pkgload::load_all(".")
monthApp()
```

Read more at [mastering-shiny.org](https://mastering-shiny.org/) and [r-pkgs.org](https://r-pkgs.org/).
